title: dryopteris × holttumii
intro: Dryopteris × holttumii, commonly known as Holttum's wood fern or Holttum's fern, is a sterile hybrid of the Dryopteris species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris × holttumii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic, making it potentially useful in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
